legacy_rows.legacy_label: RESOLVED during cross-session re-verification: NFL.com's detailed standings tail columns were decoded and validated arithmetically for all 32 teams (HOME+ROAD = W-L-T record; DIV% and CONF% recompute exactly from DIV/CONF). data/standings-2026-reg-w8.json now carries W,L,T,PCT,PF,PA,NET,HOME,ROAD,DIV,DIV%,CONF,CONF%,STRK. Two remaining rendered tail columns (positions 14 and 16) could not be label-verified and are still omitted rather than guessed. An earlier in-session capture had mislabeled positions 8-9 as DIV/CONF; corrected and logged in COORDINATION.md.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Team affiliation is not rendered on NFL.com player-stats leader pages (rushing/receiving/interceptions). The 'team' field is therefore null in data/player-rushing-2026.json, data/player-receiving-2026.json, data/player-interceptions-2026.json, and null for 4 QBs (C.J. Stroud, Brock Purdy, Tyler Shough, Trevor Lawrence) in data/player-passing-2026.json (all other QBs verified against the Next Gen Stats Week 8 table, which renders TEAM). Team can be confirmed on each player's official page (player_url column).
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Two trailing columns on the NFL.com receiving leaders page could not be label-verified arithmetically from the capture; they are stored as neutral keys tail_10 / tail_11 in data/player-receiving-2026.json and are NOT shown as labeled stats on the site.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: As of 2026-11-03, NFL.com has not yet published the Week 9 injury report (https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg9 redirects to Week 8). The latest official report is Week 8 (captured in data/injuries-2026-week8.json, partial: players with Out/Questionable status in the captured portion). Week 9 game statuses must be re-checked against the official report once published before any Week 9 selection is acted on.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Market betting lines (spreads/totals) are NOT published by the NFL or any official league source. Values seen on third-party aggregators (nflschedules.com showing 'FanDuel' spreads; an ESPN scoreboard capture showing 'SF -10, Total 48.5') are recorded in data/market-lines.json as UNVERIFIED third-party values. Live lines must be verified at a licensed sportsbook's own site; in the Netherlands only Ksa-licensed providers may be used (check https://kansspelautoriteit.nl/kansspelwijzer). Lines move constantly — treat any captured line as time-stamped and stale.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Third-party sites disagree with official NFL.com records for some teams as of 2026-11-03 (e.g., an ESPN scoreboard capture showed BAL 4-3, LAC 0-6, SF 6-1 with different W9 slate records; nflschedules.com showed different records again). Official NFL.com standings (https://www.nfl.com/standings/) are treated as authoritative everywhere in this project; all third-party discrepancies are discarded, not averaged.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Model line assumptions (e.g., home-field advantage of 2.5 points, edge threshold of 1.0 point, vig/juice of -110) are ANALYTICAL ASSUMPTIONS of this project, not values from any official source. They are labeled as assumptions wherever used (analysis/model-lines-week9.json, research docs) and are adjustable parameters, not facts.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: NFL.com player-stats leader pages paginate; captures contain the top 25 rows per category as rendered (sorted by the chosen stat, desc). Players outside the top 25 are available on the official source pages but were not captured into the JSON to keep the dataset reviewable.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Turnover margin (a common 'luck' metric) requires fumble data, which is not present in the captured team stat categories; only INT-based proxies are computed. Fumble-based luck adjustment is therefore NOT applied — flagged so no one assumes it was.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: This project is a research/analytics competition framework. It does not place, facilitate, or intermediate any real-money wager. Leaderboard 'rewards' are points/trophies only. Gambling can be addictive — in the Netherlands only use Ksa-licensed providers (https://kansspelautoriteit.nl/), self-exclude via CRUKS (https://kansspelautoriteit.nl/uitsluitregister-cruks), and in the US call 1-800-GAMBLER (https://www.ncpgambling.org/). Strictly 18+ (NL) / 21+ where required by local law.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Parallel session's capture data/nfl-2026-standings.csv (session 9cf451e4, source nfl.com/standings): its 'div' column actually matches the HOME record column and its 'conf' matches CONF — its div/home labels appear swapped. W,L,T,PCT,PF,PA,NET,streak match this session's JSON on all 32 teams (see analysis/verification.json). The CSV is retained for provenance; use data/standings-2026-reg-w8.json for labeled values.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Parallel session's player CSVs data/nfl-2026-{passing,rushing,receiving}.csv were sourced from Next Gen Stats REG/1 (Week 1) and self-flagged UNVERIFIED by that session (IR-01: totals inconsistent with games played). They are NOT used by this session's pipeline; this session uses season-through-Week-8 captures from nfl.com/stats/player-stats and nextgenstats.nfl.com .../REG/8 instead.
legacy_rows.status: UNVERIFIED legacy row; numeric values withheld. Selected independently checked fields appear only on Verified Data.

legacy_rows.legacy_label: Session 9cf451e4's original site tree (index.html, pages/, assets/, docs/executive-summary.md) was relocated verbatim to archive/session-9cf451e4-own8/ during final integration so this session's unified dashboard can serve from the repo root (GitHub Pages: main /). Relative links inside the archive were preserved (its data/ copies included). Their irregularities IR-02 (direct curl blocked; fetch_page used) and IR-03 (some nfl.com stats URLs 404 in their session; nextgenstats used) are recorded here for the record.
